subject: Data Engineering
title: What Is Data Governance?
description: One-minute skill: What Is Data Governance?.

hook.text: Who can access the salary table? Who approved the schema change? Who deleted last week's data?

buildup.text: Data governance is the set of policies, roles, and processes that manage data availability and security.

discovery.text: It answers three questions: who can access what data, how should it be handled, and who is accountable?

twist.text: Governance without tooling is just a document nobody reads. It must be enforced in pipelines and systems.

climax.text: Effective governance balances access with control — enabling data use without enabling data abuse.

punchline.text: Governance isn't red tape. It's the rules that build trust.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of data governance?
options: Managing data availability, security, and accountability
